$comment: SealLink v1.0 Safe-by-Design Off-Chain Locator URI Scheme Registry (SPEC-00 §5, SPEC-03 §4). Forward-compatible via Step 8b runtime registry enforcement: forbidden_schemes refuse WIRE_MEMBER, allowed_schemes validate strictly and allow SSRF-guarded fetch, and unrecognized future schemes pass wire validation but MUST NEVER be auto-fetched by older verifiers.

syntax_invariants.display_only_exception: Human-clicked seallink-card/1 links[] are display-only hyperlinks (NEVER auto-fetched by verifiers) and therefore do not carry a content SHA-256.

ssrf_protection_rules.notes: Normative SSRF guard for any automatic off-chain fetch initiated from untrusted manifest, card, mirror, relay, service.endpoint, or profile-section locators. Verifiers MUST resolve DNS, unwrap IPv4-mapped/translated IPv6 addresses, reject all RFC 6890 non-globally-reachable IP ranges, dial the validated IP directly (preventing DNS-rebinding TOCTOU while keeping SNI/Host for TLS), forbid cross-scheme redirects (0 redirects on Channel 2 /.well-known/; <= 3 same-scheme HTTPS redirects elsewhere with per-hop revalidation), ignore or SSRF-filter embedded magnet tr=/ws=/xs=/x.pe= and Nostr relay hints, enforce response byte ceilings, and verify SHA-256 content addressing before parsing.

allowed_schemes.description: TLS-authenticated HTTPS fetch (optionally pinned with tls_spki_sha256); cleartext http:// is forbidden.
Content-addressed Blossom (BUD-01) blob server URI; dereferenced strictly over HTTPS/TLS (default port 443) with identical SSRF guards.

BitTorrent v2 (BEP 52) magnet URI requiring xt=urn:btmh:1220<64hex> (or legacy xt=urn:btih:...); embedded tr=/ws=/xs=/x.pe= parameters MUST be ignored for auto-fetch unless strictly HTTPS and SSRF-validated.
NIP-19 bech32 Nostr entity URI (nevent1, naddr1, note1, npub1, nprofile1); embedded relay hints MUST obey wss:// + SSRF rules.
SSH File Transfer Protocol locator without embedded credentials (authentication is out-of-band; NEVER auto-fetched without explicit operator configuration to prevent SSH key/username probing).
